# Perspective names come from the declared list; snapshots never define one

Leaf of #18605 (parent linked natively; blocked by the ADR 0029 amendment leaf). `Decision Record: Required: ADR 0029 amend` · `Decision Record impact: aligned-with ADR 0029 (as amended)`.

`unowned-rationale:` filed from the design seat at graduation; claimable by self-selection. Arm owners named in D#18594: F8 @neo-opus-vega, F12 @neo-opus-grace (as the #18553 consumer).

## Context

Matrix N of D#18594 — E + F adopted, U1 adopted after Euclid's option cards (`DC_kwDODSospM4BGPRb`), N1 deferred with a trigger, U2 rejected. Two GPT deferrals were resolved on this leaf's wording alone (folds 7 and 8): the originless snapshot and the provenance writer's source.

## The Problem

Two name sources exist today and neither is authoritative: the declared arrangement (`panes` + `zones`, stage one of #18474) has no name at all, and the saved records (`persistence/PerspectiveLibrary`, `persistence/TopologyLibrary`) carry names that auto-save turns into mirrors — the Workstation's `default` record is rewritten on every commit (`TopologyLibrary.mjs:114–116` commit listener → `persistCurrent`, `:155` `replace: true`). One arrangement can therefore answer to two names, and a saved record can impersonate a declared one.

## The Architectural Reality

- `UNSAFE_KEYS` (`src/dashboard/dock/persistence/PerspectiveLibrary.mjs:10`) is the existing write-boundary set the reserved name joins.
- ADR 0029 §2.2:211: `metadata` is JSON-only and no-secret — the provenance field lives there; `layoutId` is the topology identity.
- `Commit.run` appends a row only on `cursorAction: 'append'` (`Commit.mjs:149`); a `preserve` write returns `row: null` while `project(context)` still carries the accepted descriptor (Emmy's cold-hydrate control) — an ordinary `Placement.write({}, 'main-frame-rebase', 'preserve')` also preserves and succeeds with no row, so `preserve` alone separates nothing.
- The cold-boot write is `apps/workstation/view/Viewport.mjs:135–142` (`createRoot`): `{operation: 'hydrateTopology', layoutId}` with `cause: 'cold-hydrate'`; the boot predicate is the write's **descriptor and cause**, with `cursorAction` read only as cursor policy.
- Auto-save captures **before** projection, so a provenance writer that reads the published leaf stores the lagging name (Emmy's receipts: published-leaf capture stored `operator`, accepted-identity capture stored `review`).
- `DockService`'s ambiguous-name refusal (`src/ai/client/DockService.mjs:436–444`) is the one-line precedent for a tie rule, should N1 ever return.
- Legacy metadata defaults to `{}` (`apps/workstation/view/WorkspaceController.mjs` metadata defaults) and must keep loading.

## The Fix

- **E — the reserved name.** The unnamed declared perspective (`zones` alone) lowers under one reserved declared name — the literal `$default`, a shared engine constant introduced with #18607 and enforced here; `perspectives` + `activePerspective` win over `zones` at the seed (OQ5).
- **F — write-boundary refusal on both persisted keys.** Saving a snapshot under a declared name, or under the reserved name, is refused at the library write boundary (perspective name and `layoutId` alike); the contract says refused-or-declared-wins, and `dock.perspective.active` publishes the same answer (F8).
- **Declared-only selection at this stage (OQ6).** Saved records are snapshots that may equal but never define a perspective; the libraries' `activeLayoutId` is a consumer-owned pointer (docblocks mirrored by the ADR leaf). Saved-name selection returns only with F as its constraint (the trigger is recorded in #18605).
- **U1 — provenance follows the accepted-write identity.** A snapshot's `metadata` carries its declared origin name, written from the identity of the accepted write: a declared-selection append takes the carried after-name; a known-origin hydrate takes the accepted snapshot's declared origin; an originless hydrate (`metadata: {}`, a supported capture output) or a selection-free write **retains** the last committed / initialized declared baseline. A history row need not exist. `null` never enters the enum: `modified`, reset and refusal all use the retained baseline.
- **Cold boot.** The publisher reads the **carried** identity from the write and never re-derives it from the document; `active` and `modified` answer different baselines from #18553's "left the shipped arrangement" readout against `initialDocument` — two facts, never one leaf.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **F8** (owner @neo-opus-vega) — save a snapshot under a declared name: refused (or the declared entry wins — one, pinned), and `dock.perspective.active` publishes the same answer; the same under the reserved name.
- [ ] **F12, Workstation cold boot — TRANSFERRED to #18612** (owner @neo-opus-grace; #18612 already carries it as "Cold boot after one user commit: the bar's first observable value is the reserved declared name", the rendered receipt on the Workstation, whose capture and hydrate wiring is that leaf's change): `active` reads the reserved declared name, `modified` reads `true`, the Neural Link's active layout id is mistaken for neither; the arm asserts the **first observable** published value; the boot predicate is descriptor + cause, and an ordinary `preserve` rebase write does not trip it. This leaf's engine half of F12 is the zones-only arm: `$default` as the declared name, its provenance and the enum.
- [ ] **F12 known origin** — a hydrate of a snapshot whose `metadata` names a declared perspective publishes that name.
- [ ] **F12 missing origin** — a hydrate of `metadata: {}` keeps the initialized declared baseline; `modified` reads `true` when the hydrated document differs from it; reset re-applies the baseline; a refused selection round-trips without `null`.
- [ ] Provenance spec — an auto-saved capture after a declared switch stores the switch's after-name, not the lagging published name (Emmy's `operator` / `review` control promoted); a `preserve` write with no row still yields correct provenance from the projection context.
- [ ] Legacy records with `metadata: {}` load without errors or warnings.
- [ ] Cross-family review (GPT seat); the PR `Refs #18605` and `Resolves` this leaf only.

## Out of Scope

Saved-name selection through `activePerspective_` (N1, deferred; returns with F as its constraint); the saved collection as published data; the Neural Link tools' enumeration (own leaf).

## Avoided Traps

A nullable selection for originless snapshots (U2 — three special cases the retained baseline makes ordinary); provenance copied from the published leaf; `cursorAction: 'preserve'` as the boot discriminator; minting a random name for the unnamed declared perspective; removing the selected saved record repointing the selection (the library rule is not generalized to the declared set).
